test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 9 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

We have _______ long weekend ahead.
solution:
The correct answer is, '**a'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A is an indefinite article used for nouns with consonant sounds.
 
 
• Example, ***a good trip***, ***a beautiful garden***, and ***a lovely home***.
